fr-tipi-rrn.name: France - road events on the national non-concessioned network (Bison Futé / DIR), hourly aggregate
fr-tipi-rrn.attribution: Source: Bison Futé / directions interdépartementales des routes (DIR), via transport.data.gouv.fr, Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab)
fr-tipi-rrn.notes: License checked 2026-09-26 at https://transport.data.gouv.fr/datasets/evenements-routiers-sur-le-reseau-routier-national-non-concede (Licence Ouverte 2.0, no registration). Resource 79174 is the hourly aggregate (one file); 79173 is a directory of per-event files.

nl-ndw.name: Netherlands - NDW roadworks and events planning feed (DATEX II v3)
nl-ndw.sourceLicense: NDW open data (license text not confirmed)
nl-ndw.notes: OFF until the license is settled: file access needs no login, but NDW's own license text was not found on opendata.ndw.nu or docs.ndw.nu on 2026-09-26 (only the parent agency's general 'open, tenzij' policy). Ask mail@servicedeskndw.nu, then set enabled to true. ~18 MB gzip per fetch.

de-autobahn.name: Germany - Die Autobahn GmbH des Bundes, own JSON API (not DATEX II)
de-autobahn.attribution: Source: Die Autobahn GmbH des Bundes (verkehr.autobahn.de) - terms of reuse not stated by the publisher
de-autobahn.notes: OFF by default: the API publishes no license or terms of use (docs/sources.md, checked 2026-09-26). Chosen by the operator as the German source; rows are marked sourceLicense=ungeklärt. Turn on deliberately with AUTOBAHN_API_ENABLED=true or ROADWORKS_FEEDS_ON=de-autobahn. ~110 requests per pass (one for the road list, one per road; 108 roads on 2026-09-26).
